approach: notes
numbers: Search budget: ~34 WebSearch calls + several GitHub code searches. WebFetch/curl to journals, PMC, Crossref, OSF, Zenodo, IUSCA all blocked (proxy 403 / DNS). Every number below comes from search-result text (abstract snippets) or from GitHub-hosted notes, not from a full paper read, unless stated otherwise. Several high-value CC BY sources were FOUND but their tables could NOT be read (Piper IJSC 10RM norms; Sigvaldsen PLOS ONE; Fernandes Behav Sci). They are listed with numbers_status='not extracted' so someone with normal web access can pull the tables.

sources.citation: General legal position (not legal advice)
sources.licence_evidence: US: Feist v. Rural (1991): facts are not copyrightable; only original selection/arrangement/expression is. EU/UK: the sui generis database right can restrict extracting a substantial part of a database (relevant to scraping app/website datasets such as Strength Level), but reusing a few published means/SDs from a paper does not do that.
sources.reasoning: Means, SDs and ratios reported in a paywalled or NC/ND paper can be used as facts with citation. Do not copy table layouts, text or figures, and do not bulk-copy proprietary standards tables.

approach: ratio to barbell bench press (same subjects)
numbers: 1RM, kg, mean +- SD; 24 sport-sciences students (12 men, 12 women). Horizontal bench press: men 94.2 +- 14.6, women 45.4 +- 10.1. Incline bench press: men 87.7 +- 11.6, women 41.6 +- 6.6. Seated military press (SMP): men 67.4 +- 7.8, women 37.3 +- 6.3. Load-velocity profiles were tested from 20% to 100% 1RM in 5% steps. Probably all on a Smith machine (not verified, check the full text).

approach: ratio to barbell bench press (6RM regression, same subjects)
numbers: 29 physically active college students (Hong Kong). Estimated 1RM bench 54.31 +- 14.60 kg (1RM/BW 0.80 +- 0.22). 6RM loads were tested. Prediction: DB shoulder press 6RM = 0.42 x bench-press 6RM + 5.84 kg (r with bench 0.80-0.93 across the four assistance lifts). Other equations: hammer curl = 0.28 x BP + 6.30; overhead triceps extension = 0.33 x BP - 0.60.

ratio_value_if_derivable.note: Unclear whether the DB load is one dumbbell or both. Combined is more plausible: per-dumbbell 25 kg+ at a 54 kg bench is unrealistic. If combined, per-dumbbell is about 0.25-0.28 x bench 6RM. Assumes 6RM ratios are roughly equal to 1RM ratios. Sex mix not stated in the snippet.
